lines.en: label treasureisland:
scene unmatchingeyes1
We’re attacked by a violent storm on the way back from the forest.
lines.zh: 从森林回来的路上，我们遭遇了一场猛烈的暴风雨。

lines.en: It made first contact while we were still beneath the trees, so there was no point in seeking shelter once we finally escaped.
lines.zh: 我们还在树林底下的时候，它就完成了初次接触，所以等我们终于逃出来时，再去找地方躲雨已经没有意义了。

lines.en: The damage had already been done. Our clothes, which were already half-soaked from mist and sweat, are now plastered to our bodies as if extensions of our skin.
lines.zh: 伤害已经造成。我们的衣服本来就被雾气和汗水浸得半湿，如今更是像皮肤延伸出来的一部分一样，紧紧贴在身上。

lines.en: And each time I go to separate the layers, a piece of me is torn off.
lines.zh: 而每当我想要把这一层层剥开，就会有一块我自己被撕下来。

lines.en: Kaori hasn’t spoken much.
lines.zh: Kaori 没怎么说话。

lines.en: She’s likely upset with me, but I’m not too beaten up over it.
lines.zh: 她大概是在生我的气，但我并不太往心里去。

lines.en: It was her idea to embark on this pointless journey. And if it weren’t for my intolerance brought on by an atmosphere that did not sit right with me, we’d likely still be out there.
lines.zh: 踏上这趟毫无意义的旅程本来就是她的主意。要不是我受不了那种让我浑身不对劲的气氛，我们大概现在还在外面。

lines.en: Wading through the water.
lines.zh: 在水里跋涉。

lines.en: Filling the spaces between our nails and flesh with dirt and rocks, all in search of a treasure that doesn’t exist in the first place.
lines.zh: 把泥土和石子塞满指甲与皮肉之间的缝隙，只为寻找一件从一开始就不存在的宝物。

lines.en: Maybe I’ve been wasting my time alongside this girl.
lines.zh: 也许我一直在和这个女孩一起浪费时间。

lines.en: I don’t want to have sex with her. And while I’ve grown more accustomed to her vocabulary and what certain things mean, I spend more time than not simply trying to keep up.
lines.zh: 我不想和她做爱。虽然我已经越来越习惯她的用词、也大概明白某些话的意思，但我花的大部分精力，都只是用来努力跟上她。

lines.en: It’s exhausting.
lines.zh: 这很累人。

lines.en: I understand why everyone always leaves.
lines.zh: 我明白为什么所有人最后都会离开。

lines.en: But-
lines.zh: 可是——

lines.en: There is something familiar about her presence.
lines.zh: 她的存在之中有某种熟悉的东西。

lines.en: It comforts me in a way not much else does anymore.
lines.zh: 它以一种如今已不多见的方式安慰着我。

lines.en: But at the same time-
lines.zh: 但与此同时——

lines.en: It steals my breath away in a manner not fit for TV drama.
lines.zh: 它又用一种完全不适合电视剧的方式夺走我的呼吸。

lines.en: The air is heavy when I am with her.
lines.zh: 和她在一起时，空气是沉重的。

lines.en: And there is an indescribable emptiness that follows the two of us like the moon from the windows of a moving car.
lines.zh: 而有一种难以言喻的空虚跟在我们身后，就像行驶的车窗外那轮月亮。

lines.en: : I am sorry the sky is crying on us, Friend. I think something may have pierced the clouds and caused them pain.
lines.zh: : 我很抱歉天空在对我们哭泣，朋友。我想也许是有什么东西刺穿了云，让它们感到了疼痛。

lines.en: : You’ve apologized for that same thing nine times now. Don’t worry about it. It’s not your fault.
lines.zh: : 你已经为同一件事道歉九次了。别放在心上，这不是你的错。

lines.en: : But it is due to me that you must soak up the sky tears.
lines.zh: : 可是你必须承受这些天空的眼泪，都是因为我。

lines.en: : All of the sadness in all of the world crashes down around us like whapam, baboom, shhhhh.
lines.zh: : 全世界所有的悲伤都朝我们砸下来，哗啦、轰隆、嘶——。

lines.en: : It takes me back to days filled with white and dreams dreamt in the dark.
lines.zh: : 它让我想起那些填满白色的日子，和做在黑暗里的梦。

lines.en: : Do you think almost dying made you appreciate life more?
lines.zh: : 你觉得，差点死掉这件事让你更珍惜生命了吗？

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes2
: My brainspace is too full of bugs and baguettes to remember such things.
lines.zh: : 我的脑空间里塞满了虫子和法棍，记不住这些事。

lines.en: : But I love this planet.
lines.zh: : 但我爱这颗星球。

lines.en: : Planet? Or {i}city?{/i} Because we’re not able to leave and I assume you barely know anything about the world beyond the walls.
lines.zh: : 星球？还是{i}城市{/i}？因为我们出不去，而且我猜你对城墙之外的世界几乎一无所知。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes3
: It is possible to know things without encountering them.
lines.zh: : 有些事情，不必亲身经历也可以知道。

lines.en: : The earth sphere is large and full of mystical things that I hope to one day see.
lines.zh: : 地球球体很大，装满了神秘的东西，我希望有一天能亲眼看看。

lines.en: : I wish to return to the Gunma my smaller self would see.
lines.zh: : 我想回到小时候的我所看见的那个群马。

lines.en: : I wish to fluff the beards of large desert cats and touch face-points with the koalas of kangaroo land.
lines.zh: : 我想去揉一揉大型沙漠猫的胡须，和袋鼠之地的考拉贴贴脸。

lines.en: : Is there anything you wish for, Friend? Anything outside of the town we call home?
lines.zh: : 朋友，你有什么愿望吗？在这座我们称之为家的小镇之外？

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes4
: I just want to feel normal.
lines.zh: : 我只想感觉自己是个正常人。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes5
: Normal?
lines.zh: : 正常？

lines.en: : It’s not something you’d understand. Which I guess is probably why it’s okay for me to say this to you in the first place. I don’t have to worry about you...looking at me any differently.
lines.zh: : 这不是你能理解的东西。我想，大概也正因为如此，我才会把这些话说给你听。我不用担心你……用不一样的眼光看我。

lines.en: : You know, I’ve been doing that a lot lately. {i}Opening up{/i} to people.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我最近经常这样。向别人{i}敞开心扉{/i}。

lines.en: : I’m still not very good at it. And I’m not even sure how or...{i}when{/i} it started.
lines.zh: : 我还是不太擅长。而且我甚至不确定这是怎么开始的、又是……{i}什么时候{/i}开始的。

lines.en: : But the longer this goes on, the harder it is to keep everything inside.
lines.zh: : 可这件事持续得越久，我就越难把一切都憋在心里。

lines.en: : Am I any different from the way I was when you met me, Kaori?
lines.zh: : Kaori，我和你刚认识的时候相比，有哪里不一样了吗？

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes6
: It’s like you haven’t aged a day.
lines.zh: : 你看起来仿佛一天都没有变老。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes7
: What?...
: You are the same as when I met you, just more alone and less hungry.
lines.zh: : 你和我刚认识你的时候一模一样，只是更孤独了一点，也没那么饿了。

lines.en: : As the earth globe spins for you and things become more confusing, it is the opposite for me.
lines.zh: : 地球球体为你转动，事情对你来说越来越难懂，对我却恰恰相反。

lines.en: : I am bad at understanding feelings and have not yet figured out how to “geometry,” but I am more careful about the things I do that others do not enjoy.
lines.zh: : 我很不擅长理解感情，也还没弄明白该怎么「几何」，但我对自己做的那些别人不喜欢的事，已经小心多了。

lines.en: : So if there are parts of me you wish to dispose of, please write them down on a tree and tape them to my entry-block. It is the quickest way for me to learn.
lines.zh: : 所以，如果你希望我改掉身上的某些部分，请把它们写在树上，再贴到我的门牌方块上。那是我学得最快的方法。

lines.en: : Unorthodox, but okay. I’ll try and remember that.
lines.zh: : 做法挺另类的，不过好吧。我会尽量记住。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes8
: You’re...{i}a lot{/i} sometimes, Kaori.
lines.zh: : Kaori，你有时候……真的很让人{i}吃不消{/i}。

lines.en: : I...have learned enough about the human language to understand you are not saying I am more than one person. But if you could continue to describe why I am more than myself, it would be helpful.
lines.zh: : 我……学的人类语言已经够多了，明白你不是在说我「不止一个人」。但如果你能继续说明一下，为什么我会「多于我自己」，那会很有帮助。

lines.en: : I mean that it isn’t always fun to be around you. It’s a lot of...work.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，和你待在一起并不总是有趣。那是很多……辛苦。

lines.en: : Like, tonight for example. Or when you took me to this same exact alley in pursuit of chickens. Or when we came {i}back{/i} to this alley {i}again{/i} to {i}find{/i} a {i}specific{/i} chicken.
lines.zh: : 比如说今晚。还有你带我去同一条巷子追鸡的那次。还有我们{i}再{/i}{i}回到{/i}这条巷子来{i}找{/i}某一只{i}特定{/i}的鸡的那次。

lines.en: : As another person who isn’t always fun to be around, there probably isn’t any reason for me to point this out other than to make you aware of it.
lines.zh: : 作为一个同样不总是让人觉得有趣的人，我大概没什么理由指出这一点，只是想让你知道而已。

lines.en: : No matter what I silently think to myself, I know I’m going to stick around you. I feel kind of...obligated to at this point.
lines.zh: : 不管我心里默默怎么想，我知道我会一直待在你身边。到这个地步，我有点觉得……这是一种义务。

lines.en: : Just...don’t take it too hard if it ever seems like I’m getting upset with you.
lines.zh: : 只是……如果哪天看起来我在生你的气，别太往心里去。

lines.en: : I’m only human at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 说到底，我也只是个普通人。

lines.en: : You, though? Who even knows...
lines.zh: : 可你呢？谁知道呢……

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes9
: It makes your brain go in circles, does it not?
lines.zh: : 这让你的脑子转起圈来了，是不是？

lines.en: : Humans only get one life, and yet this is the second for me.
lines.zh: : 人类只有一条命，而这对我来说已经是第二条了。

lines.en: : I look the way a human does. I am learning human words. I have human fingers and human toes and I live in a human house.
lines.zh: : 我看起来像人类。我在学人类的语言。我有人的手指、人的脚趾，也住在人类的房子里。

lines.en: : But my heart is something else.
lines.zh: : 可我的心是别的东西。

lines.en: : And the tubes and wires that line my body are something else as well.
lines.zh: : 而我身体里那些密密麻麻的管子和电线，也是别的东西。

lines.en: : It is {i}all{/i} something else, and that something never feels right.
lines.zh: : {i}一切{/i}都是别的东西，而那个东西，从来都不对劲。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes10
: {b}THaT SOmetHIng nEVer FEelS RIgHT!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}那 个 东 西 从 来 都 不 对 劲 ！{/b}

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes11
: ...Kaori?
lines.zh: : ……Kaori？

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes6
: {b}Every day I grow some more.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}每一天，我都会多长出一点。{/b}

lines.en: scene happy1
scene happy2
scene happy1
scene happy2
scene happy1
scene happy2
scene unmatchingeyes12
An indescribable emptiness follows the two of us like the moon from the windows of a moving car.
lines.zh: 有一种难以言喻的空虚跟在我们身后，就像行驶的车窗外那轮月亮。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes13
But instead of racing headfirst into another, it crashes into the wall instead.
lines.zh: 但它没有一头撞进另一片空虚，而是撞上了那堵墙。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes14
And from behind that wall emerges something that words alone can not describe.
lines.zh: 而从那堵墙后面，浮现出了某种光靠语言无法描述的东西。

lines.en: From behind that wall is something that should not exist.
lines.zh: 从那堵墙后面走出来的，是不该存在的东西。

lines.en: An orb of light.
lines.zh: 一颗光的球体。

lines.en: A tree with roots of wire.
lines.zh: 一棵长着电线根须的树。

lines.en: A voice inside your head.
lines.zh: 一个在你脑海里的声音。

lines.en: And it would have never seen the fading light of this world if it were not for us.
lines.zh: 如果不是因为我们，它永远都不会看见这个世界渐渐黯淡的光。

lines.en: The ones who were driving.
lines.zh: 那些一直在开车的人。

lines.en: The ones who still sit behind that wheel.
lines.zh: 那些至今仍坐在方向盘后面的人。

lines.en: And who stare on in disbelief at all of the carnage we have caused.
lines.zh: 他们难以置信地注视着我们造成的这一切惨状。

lines.en: O world-
lines.zh: 哦，世界啊——

lines.en: In our final moments-
lines.zh: 在我们最后的时刻——

lines.en: Please answer me this-
lines.zh: 请回答我这个问题——

lines.en: Why?
lines.zh: 为什么？

lines.en: Why did it have to be him?
lines.zh: 为什么非得是他？

lines.en: : Friend...
lines.zh: : 朋友……

lines.en: : {i}Look...{/i}
scene unmatchingeyes15
: At what? Another chi-
lines.zh: : 看什么？又一只鸡——

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes16
scene black
Kaori was wrong.
lines.zh: Kaori 错了。

lines.en: The map was leading us {i}here.{/i}
lines.zh: 那张地图一直在把我们引向{i}这里{/i}。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes17
A young girl sits with her back pressed against a table.
lines.zh: 一个年轻女孩背靠着一张桌子坐在那里。

lines.en: Just like us, she is drenched in rain.
lines.zh: 和我们一样，她也被雨水浇透了。

lines.en: Yet somehow, she sleeps peacefully.
lines.zh: 可不知怎么的，她睡得很安详。

lines.en: Unmoving and barely making a noise.
lines.zh: 一动不动，几乎没有发出一点声音。

lines.en: We approach her and crouch down.
lines.zh: 我们走近她，蹲下身来。

lines.en: As I look at her, I confirm to myself something I had trouble believing mere moments ago.
lines.zh: 看着她的时候，我向自己确认了一件在片刻之前还难以相信的事。

lines.en: In fact, even now, I have trouble believing it.
lines.zh: 事实上，即便是现在，我也很难相信。

lines.en: The marking on her shirt is the same one that was on the map.
lines.zh: 她衬衫上的标记，和地图上那个一模一样。

lines.en: I hear Kaori fumbling through her back pocket to confirm the same thing.
lines.zh: 我听见 Kaori 在后口袋里翻找，想确认同一件事。

lines.en: But she makes no exclamation nor declaration once she does so.
lines.zh: 但她确认之后，既没有惊呼，也没有宣告。

lines.en: She simply puts the map back into her pocket.
lines.zh: 她只是把地图塞回口袋。

lines.en: And the two of us continue staring down at the mysterious girl.
lines.zh: 而我们两个人继续低头盯着这个神秘的女孩。

lines.en: Half worried.
lines.zh: 一半是担心。

lines.en: Half shocked.
lines.zh: 一半是震惊。

lines.en: And a third half, filled with nothing but fear for reasons I can not yet explain.
lines.zh: 还有第三个一半，里面装满了恐惧，而原因我还说不上来。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes18
As she opens her unmatching eyes and I catch my first glimpse of their colors, the fear burrows deeper into me.
lines.zh: 当她睁开那双不成对的眼睛，我第一次看清它们的颜色时，那份恐惧在我心里扎得更深了。

lines.en: I recognize both of them.
lines.zh: 这两种颜色我都认得。

lines.en: And I know for sure that this can be no coincidence.
lines.zh: 而我确信，这绝不可能是巧合。

lines.en: It must be something else.
lines.zh: 那一定是别的什么东西。

lines.en: Something that should not exist.
lines.zh: 某种不该存在的东西。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes19
scene black
And yet I can’t look away.
lines.zh: 可我依然无法移开视线。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes20
The girl shakily picks herself up off of the ground and, as I instinctively back away, I realize just how small she is.
lines.zh: 女孩颤抖着从地上爬起来，而我本能地后退一步，这才意识到她有多么娇小。

lines.en: Her sweater, so large and soaked that it’s likely half her weight right now, disguises a body that I imagine is no larger than Chinami’s or Tsukasa’s.
lines.zh: 她的毛衣又大又湿，现在的重量恐怕有她体重的一半，遮住了一具我猜想不会比 Chinami 或 Tsukasa 更大的身体。

lines.en: Perhaps even smaller — which means she’s in no state to be sleeping in an alleyway this late at night, even {i}with{/i} the city mostly devoid of predators.
lines.zh: 说不定还要更小——也就是说，{i}就算{/i}这座城市里的捕食者已经所剩无几，她也不该在这种深夜里睡在巷子里。

lines.en: Would I have preyed upon her if I had come here alone?
lines.zh: 如果我是独自来到这里的，我会把她当成猎物吗？

lines.en: Or is my gut right in telling me that {i}I{/i} would somehow be the prey?
lines.zh: 还是说，我的直觉是对的——在某个层面上，{i}我{/i}才是那个猎物？

lines.en: : Hello, tiny human. What are you doing out here in the sky-tears? You should be back at house.
lines.zh: : 你好，小小的人类。你在这天空的眼泪里做什么呢？你应该回到房子里去。

lines.en: : You do realize I found you in essentially the same exact position recently, right?
lines.zh: : 你该不会忘了，我最近发现你的时候，你基本上就是一模一样的处境吧？

lines.en: : Have you lost your way? Do you require large human assistance?
lines.zh: : 你迷路了吗？需要大型人类的协助吗？

lines.en: : Does she even speak Japanese? She doesn’t look like she’s from around here.
lines.zh: : 她到底会不会说日语？她看起来不像本地人。

lines.en: : Do you understand us? Blink once for yes and twice for no.
lines.zh: : 你听得懂我们说话吗？眨一次眼代表是，眨两次代表不是。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes21
scene unmatchingeyes22
: Success! Thank you for your cooperation!
lines.zh: : 成功！感谢你的配合！

lines.en: : Do you have name, small human?
lines.zh: : 小人类，你有名字吗？

lines.en: : For example, I am Kaori. And the large creature behind me is “Friend.” Is there something we can call you?
lines.zh: : 比如说，我叫 Kaori。我身后那个大型生物叫「朋友」。我们该怎么称呼你呢？

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes23
scene unmatchingeyes24
scene unmatchingeyes25
: I see! Then I must give you a name myself in order to make communication easier!
lines.zh: : 我明白了！那么为了沟通方便，我必须亲自给你起个名字！

lines.en: : Kaori, you can’t just go naming girls you find in alleyways. She’s probably just too scared to speak to you right now.
lines.zh: : Kaori，你不能随随便便给在巷子里捡到的女孩起名字。她现在大概只是太害怕了，说不出话而已。

lines.en: : It is only temporary! Until her tongue wants to move again!
lines.zh: : 这只是暂时的！直到她的舌头愿意重新动起来为止！

lines.en: : From this day until more days from now, you will be called...
lines.zh: : 从今天起，到往后的更多天为止，你就叫做……

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes26
: Nao-chan!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱！

lines.en: : Nao-chan? Why {i}that?{/i}
lines.zh: : Nao 酱？为什么是{i}这个{/i}？

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes27
: The shape-block on her oversized hood-shirt!
lines.zh: : 她那件超大号连帽衫上的图形方块！

lines.en: : What a twist of events! Who would have known the treasure was a girl?!
lines.zh: : 事情的发展多么曲折啊！谁能想到宝物居然是个女孩？！

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes28
: And do not even {i}think{/i} about trafficking this one, Friend! That is an order of the non-diner variety! There will be no food involved!
lines.zh: : 还有，朋友，你连贩卖她的{i}念头{/i}都别动！这可是非餐厅点单性质的命令！其中不会牵扯任何食物！

lines.en: : I’m not going to {i}traffic{/i} anyone. We should just take her to the police and let them figure out where she’s supposed to-
lines.zh: : 我不会{i}贩卖{/i}任何人。我们应该把她交给警察，让他们查清楚她本来该——

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes29
scene unmatchingeyes30
scene unmatchingeyes31
: The police are your friends, Nao-chan. They will help you get to the location you need to be located at or in.
lines.zh: : 警察是你的朋友哦，Nao 酱。他们会帮你抵达你该被安置的地点或位置。

lines.en: : Friend, I do not think she wants to go to the police.
lines.zh: : 朋友，我觉得她不想去警察局。

lines.en: : Wow, I wonder what gave you that idea?
lines.zh: : 哇，真不知道你是怎么看出来的？

lines.en: : Nao-chan, would you like to come home with me? I have a very large cock.
lines.zh: : Nao 酱，你愿意跟我回家吗？我有一只很大的鸡。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes32
: Chicken.
lines.zh: : 公鸡。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes33
: Then it is a settlement! Nao-chan will stay in my housing-cube until she is ready to leave!
lines.zh: : 那就这么定了！在 Nao 酱准备好离开之前，她都会住在我的住房方块里！

lines.en: : Kaori...I just want to throw it out there that what you’re proposing is {i}probably{/i} extremely illegal. And you give me shit for trafficking girls all the time, so...
lines.zh: : Kaori……我只是想说一句，你提出的这个做法{i}恐怕{/i}是严重违法的。而且你天天因为贩卖女孩的事数落我，所以……

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes34
: There are no worries to be worried, Friend. Nao-chan has special eyes just like me. Everyone will make the assumption that our blood is somewhat similar. Right, Nao-chan?
lines.zh: : 没有什么需要担心的，朋友。Nao 酱和我一样，有一双特别的眼睛。所有人都会以为我们的血缘多少有些相近。对吧，Nao 酱？

lines.en: : See?!
lines.zh: : 看吧！

lines.en: : Everything will work out perfectly!
lines.zh: : 一切都会顺利得完美无缺！

lines.en: scene black
: I am sure of it!
lines.zh: : 我对此确信无疑！

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes35
We make it back to Kaori’s apartment with “Nao-chan” in tow, but I notice a distinct lack of oversized fowls upon arrival.
lines.zh: 我们带着「Nao 酱」回到了 Kaori 的公寓，可一到地方我就发现，那些超大号的家禽一只都不见了。

lines.en: How John made it through the door, I have no idea. But there are much bigger issues at hand here...
lines.zh: John 是怎么进门的，我完全想不通。但眼下还有更严重的问题……

lines.en: And I’m reluctant to let Kaori spontaneously become a foster-mom out of nowhere all because a sketchy “map” was taped to her door tonight.
lines.zh: 而且我不太愿意让 Kaori 就因为今晚有人把一张来路不明的「地图」贴在她的门上，就莫名其妙地变成一个养母。

lines.en: There’s something wrong with all of this.
lines.zh: 这一切都不对劲。

lines.en: But...
lines.zh: 可是……

lines.en: She seems innocent.
lines.zh: 她看起来很无辜。

lines.en: I’m not just...over-thinking this, am I?
lines.zh: 我……应该不只是想太多了吧？

lines.en: : Nao-chan, you can sleep wherever you like! Other than the sharpest corner of the room so you do not get trampled by my chicken companion.
lines.zh: : Nao 酱，你想睡哪里都行！只是别睡在房间里最尖的那个角落，免得被我的鸡伙伴踩扁。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes36
No. There’s no way.
lines.zh: 不。不可能。

lines.en: I mean...{i}look at her.{/i}
lines.zh: 我是说……{i}看看她{/i}。

lines.en: What am I afraid of?
lines.zh: 我到底在怕什么？

lines.en: She’s just a normal little girl.
lines.zh: 她只是个正常的小女孩。

lines.en: A normal little girl with...eyes matching the two most important figures in my life and...a marking on her shirt that is an exact copy of the one on Kaori’s map...
lines.zh: 一个正常的小女孩，却有着……和我生命中最重要的两个人相同的眼睛，还有……衬衫上一个和 Kaori 那张地图上一模一样的标记……

lines.en: Just when will the ground stop shaking?
lines.zh: 大地究竟要到什么时候才会停止摇晃？

lines.en: : I have increased my friend count by 100%%!
lines.zh: : 我的朋友数量增加了 100%%！

lines.en: : Yeah, by plucking a mysterious girl out of an alley and taking her back to your apartment. I hope you’re proud of yourself.
lines.zh: : 是啊，靠从巷子里捡回一个神秘女孩、带回你的公寓。我希望你为自己感到骄傲。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes37
: Is this one of those instances where I am considered more than one person?
lines.zh: : 这就是你所说的「很让人吃不消」的那种情况吗？

lines.en: : The term is “a lot.” And yes. Do you have any idea how weird this is?
lines.zh: : 那个说法是「很让人吃不消」。对，就是。你知道这有多奇怪吗？

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes38
: Do you have a problem with Nao-chan, Friend?
lines.zh: : 朋友，你对 Nao 酱有什么意见吗？

lines.en: : No, I don’t have a...{i}problem{/i} with her, it’s just...there’s something weird about this. You can see that, right?
lines.zh: : 不，我对她没有……{i}意见{/i}，只是……这事有点不对劲。你看得出来吧？

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes39
: Tell me more about your human feelings outside of the sleep-room. Nao-chan needs her rest.
lines.zh: : 那请你到睡觉的房间外面，再和我说说你的人类感情吧。Nao 酱需要休息。

lines.en: scene black
scene unmatchingeyes40
: Kaori-
lines.zh: : Kaori——

lines.en: : I understand that what is happening is not normal.
lines.zh: : 我明白，现在发生的事并不正常。

lines.en: : I may have trouble expressing certain things and comprehending certain feelings, but I have existed for long enough to understand that you should not kidnap children.
lines.zh: : 我也许很难表达某些东西、很难理解某些感情，但我已经存在了足够长的时间，足以明白人不应该绑架小孩。

lines.en: : Then why-
lines.zh: : 那为什么——

lines.en: : Because I can not leave her alone.
lines.zh: : 因为我没法丢下她不管。

lines.en: : She reminds me too much of myself. Or at least the me I think I was before I became the me I am.
lines.zh: : 她让我想起太多我自己。或者说，想起在变成如今的我之前，我以为的那个我。

lines.en: : I will take care of her and protect her as a member of my family. The same way I take care of John.
lines.zh: : 我会照顾她、保护她，把她当作家人。就像我照顾 John 一样。

lines.en: : John is not a good benchmark for how you take care of things.
lines.zh: : John 可不是衡量你照顾东西水平的好标准。

lines.en: : Nao-chan is in good hands. You do not have to worry about her.
lines.zh: : Nao 酱在我手上会很安全。你不必为她担心。

lines.en: : Unless...you are worried about her for some {i}other{/i} reason.
lines.zh: : 除非……你担心她是出于{i}别的{/i}什么原因。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes41
: {i}Is there{/i} another reason, Friend?
lines.zh: : 朋友，{i}还有{/i}别的原因吗？

lines.en: : Just...keep an eye on her. And not just as a caretaker.
lines.zh: : 只是……多留意她。而且不只是以一个看护人的身份。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes42
: I will tell you the same words I told to various furry-friend adoption shelters throughout Kumon-mi. You can trust me to not inflict harm upon this living creature.
lines.zh: : 那我就把我在 Kumon-mi 各处毛茸茸朋友领养所说过的同一番话再说一遍。你可以相信我，不会伤害这个活生生的生灵。

lines.en: : It suddenly makes more sense why no one has given you a dog yet.
lines.zh: : 这下我更明白为什么至今没人肯给你一只狗了。

lines.en: scene unmatchingeyes41
: Return to your shelter, the way you said you would when we left the place where the trees live.
lines.zh: : 回你自己的窝去吧，就像我们离开那些树住着的地方时你说的那样。

lines.en: : I will make your telephone bzzzz if there are any problems with Friend 2, Girl Edition.
lines.zh: : 如果朋友 2 号·女生版出了什么问题，我会让你的电话嗡嗡作响的。

lines.en: : Okay.
scene black
: Goodnight, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Kaori。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Friendburger! Do not step in any holes created by pots on the slow-run back to house!
lines.zh: : 晚安，朋友堡！慢慢跑回家的路上，别踩进那些「锅」砸出来的洞里！

lines.en: I count the streetlights on the way back home.
lines.zh: 我在回家的路上数着路灯。

lines.en: It only takes until the fourth for me to convince myself that this will all work out.
lines.zh: 还没数到第四盏，我就已经说服自己：一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: She’s just a weird girl with even weirder circumstances surrounding her appearance. And she’ll make a good match for Kaori, who’s another girl just like that.
lines.zh: 她只是个古怪的女孩，围绕着她的出现还有更古怪的境遇。而她会和 Kaori 很般配，Kaori 也是个这样的女孩。

lines.en: Both of them are strange...and nearly everything about them is all wrong in more ways than I can even count.
lines.zh: 她们两个都很奇怪……而且关于她们的一切，几乎都以数不清的方式错得离谱。

lines.en: But I’ve already gotten used to {i}one.{/i}
lines.zh: 但我已经习惯了其中{i}一个{/i}。

lines.en: Which means I could very well get used to the other too.
lines.zh: 这意味着，我也很有可能会习惯另一个。

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
Or not.
lines.zh: 也可能不会。

lines.en: scene black
I go to sleep thinking about a young girl in oversized clothing.
lines.zh: 我入睡时，脑子里想的是一个穿着超大号衣服的小女孩。

lines.en: And surprisingly enough, there’s not a single thought about removing any of it.
lines.zh: 而令人惊讶的是，我竟然没有想过要脱掉其中任何一件。

lines.en: Just momentary worries about her place in all of this...
lines.zh: 只有对她在这整件事里所处位置的短暂担忧……

lines.en: And scattered guesses at what her voice might sound like.
lines.zh: 以及零零星星的猜想——她的声音会是什么样的。

lines.en: My dreams are no different.
lines.zh: 我的梦也没什么不同。

$ kaori_love += 1
{i}Kaori’s affection has increased to [kaori_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Kaori 的好感度提升到了 [kaori_love]！{/i}

lines.en: {i}And with that, you’ve met them all.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}就这样，你已与她们全部相识。{/i}

lines.en: {i}The building blocks have been fully laid out, and little holes have been carved into each.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}积木已经全部摆好，每一块上面都凿出了小小的洞。{/i}
